findings.excerpt: Customer A 13 % 15 % 17 % Customer B 9 % 10 % 10 % Customer C 21 % 19 % 18 % Customer D 18 % 17 % 17 % Customer E 11 % 10 % 10 % We are exposed to risks associated with extending credit to customers related to the sale of products.
